latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of GitHub Subtitle Generator.

- Instantly generate accurate subtitles for video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) via cloud APIs.
- Export videos in 1080p MP4 format with options for SRT subtitle files and burned-in captions.
- No manual setup required—automatic connection and free token generation on first use.
- Simple command-based workflows: upload, subtitle, export, check credits, and review status.
- Designed for fast-paced technical content creators needing quick, accurate captions without local installation.
